battle_traits.name: Rune of Fury
battle_traits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly FYRESLAYERS units have STRIKE-FIRST while they are in combat with an enemy unit that charged in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Farsight
battle_traits.declare:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
Pick any number of enemy units that are within 10" of and visible to any friendly FYRESLAYERS units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. In addition,
for the rest of the battle round, ranged weapons, including Companion weapons, used by friendly FYRESLAYERS units have Crit (2 Hits).

battle_traits.name: Rune of Fiery Determination
battle_traits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
Friendly FYRESLAYERS units have WARD (5+) for the rest of the battle round.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Relentless Zeal
battle_traits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
For the rest of the battle round, friendly FYRESLAYERS units can use CHARGE abilities even if they used a RUN ability in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Rune of Searing Heat
battle_traits.effect:
You can only use this ability if you have not used any UR-GOLD RUNE abilities this battle round.
Melee weapons used by friendly FYRESLAYERS units have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Berserk Kindred
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY units that charged in the same turn.

abilities.name: Ancient Bloodlines
abilities.effect: Add 2 to the Health characteristic of friendly Magmadroth units.

abilities.name: Bulwark of Molten Stone
abilities.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY units while they are wholly within friendly territory.

abilities.name: Martial Pride and Stubborn Will
abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly FYRESLAYERS HEROES. In addition, the control scores of FYRESLAYERS HEROES cannot be modified by enemy abilities.

entries.name: Blood of the Berzerker
entries.effect: Add 1 to charge rolls for friendly FYRESLAYERS units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Ash-beard
entries.effect: If this unit is not a PRIEST, they have PRIEST (1). If this unit was already a PRIEST, add 1 to this unit's chanting rolls.

entries.name: Fiercely Competitive
entries.effect: If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that has STRIKE-FIRST, this unit has STRIKE-FIRST. If this unit is in combat with an enemy unit that uses the 'All-out Attack' command, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks for the rest of the turn

entries.name: Ash-cloud Rune
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly INFANTRY units cannot be targeted by shooting attacks while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Draught of the Finest Magmalt
entries.effect: Add 3 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Droth-helm
entries.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for Companion weapons used by friendly FYRESLAYERS units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Incandescent Blaze
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn:
• Double the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Roaring Fyrestream.
• This unit's Roaring Fyrestream has a Damage characteristic of 3.

entries.name: Thickened Scales
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Peerless Lineage
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a RAMPAGE ability for this unit.
entries.effect: You can pick another eligible unit to be a second target of that RAMPAGE ability. If that ability requires a roll, you must roll for each target.

entries.name: Thickened Scales
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target this unit.

entries.name: Aureate Hide
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared a FIGHT ability for this unit
entries.effect: After that FIGHT ability has been resolved, if any enemy models were slain by that FIGHT ability, you can pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST wholly within 12" of this unit. Give that PRIEST D3 ritual points.

entries.name: Intense Fyrestream
entries.effect:
Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn:
• Add X" to the Range characteristic and X to the Attacks characteristic of this unit's Companion ranged weapons, where X is equal to your fury level.
• This unit's Companion ranged weapons have Shoot in Combat.

entries.name: Prayer of Ash
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.
If the chanting roll was 8+, also subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of attacks that target that friendly unit until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Prayer of Grimnir's Fury
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS INFANTRY HERO wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this turn. After the first is used, however, the target has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.
If the chanting roll was 8+, also add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Wrath of Vulcatrix
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly MAGMADROTH unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
For the rest of the turn, the 'Battle Damaged' ability has no effect on the target and add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons.
If the chanting roll was 8+, for the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons for every 4 damage points the target has instead.

entries.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS MONSTER wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, if any damage points were inflicted on an enemy unit by the target's 'Volcanic Blood' ability, after the damage sequence has been resolved, inflict 3 mortal damage on that enemy unit. If the chanting roll was 6+, inflict D3+3 mortal damage instead.

entries.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's Companion weapons until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Blazing Impetus
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them and that was not set up this turn to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: The target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase. If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target.

entries.name: Ichor of the Ur-Salamander
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
If the chanting roll was 6+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn:
• If the target is a MAGMADROTH, each time its 'Volcanic Blood' ability would inflict 1 mortal damage on an enemy unit, inflict D3 mortal damage instead.
• If the target is a non‑MAGMADROTH unit, each time you make an unmodified save roll of 1 for a combat attack that targets that unit, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

entries.name: Fury of Vulcatrix
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect:
Add 1 to hit rolls for the target's combat attacks, including those made with Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.
In addition, if the chanting roll was 8+, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Blazing Impetus
entries.declare: Pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly FYRESLAYERS unit that was not set up this turn and that is wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Each target can use the 'Normal Move' or 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase.

entries.name: Summon Runic Fyrewall
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Runic Fyrewall on the battlefield, pick a friendly Fyreslayers Priest to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Runic Fyrewall wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Zharrgron Flame-spitter
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Zharrgron Flame-spitter on the battlefield, pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Zharrgron Flame-spitter wholly within 12" of the chanter and visible to them.

entries.name: Summon Molten Infernoth
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Molten Infernoth on the battlefield, pick a friendly FYRESLAYERS PRIEST to chant this prayer, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Molten Infernoth wholly within 12" of the chanter, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
